method: A 1x1 radial square (in the y=0 plane, centred at radius 10) swept along a right-hand helix r=10, pitch=3, turns=4: V = A * 2 pi xbar * turns = 1 * 2 pi * 10 * 4 = 80 pi. Area/centroid/bbox have no closed form and are frozen from the kernel build (6 faces, 12 edges).

edit.method: The same sweep at turns=6: V = 1 * 2 pi * 10 * 6 = 120 pi; the frozen area/centroid/bbox follow the taller helix.
